summary: Two swimmers in distress at the Cottonwood Boat Ramp on the Colorado River off Colorado River Road ~4 p.m.; one man was pulled from the water, resuscitated and hospitalized; a second man (Isaac Montaño Rivera, 32) was carried downstream, and a multi-day full rescue operation (boats, kayaks, water-rescue teams, scent dogs, drone, sonar) recovered his body near Lyons Gulch on July 26.
location: Colorado River, Cottonwood Boat Ramp / Lyons Gulch
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group; Summit County Rescue Group; Garfield County Rescue; Mountain Rescue Aspen; Colorado Search and Rescue; fire districts; Eagle County Paramedics; Eagle County Sheriff's Office; Eagle County Coroner's Office; Vail Public Safety Communications Center
notes: ECSO Media Release 07.26.23; incident date July 23 (swimmers in distress), body recovered July 26; VMRG involvement confirmed — resolves the run-550 pending 2023-07-26 water-fatality title lead. | Merged 2026-09-20 (run 925): the 07.26.23 Eagle County Sheriff release page (parent-opened live) — same incident (Isaac Montaño Rivera, 32, body recovered from the Colorado River near Lyons Gulch after the 2023-07-23 Cottonwood Boat Ramp rescue); VMRG listed among the responding agencies.
